title: subscribe_events allocates two Strings per frame for CRLF normalization
description:
client.rs subscribe_events (line 373): buf[..pos].replace("
", "
").replace('', "
") chains two String allocations per extracted frame, even when the input contains no carriage returns. JMAP SSE over HTTP/2 will never have CRLF; HTTP/1.1 chunked transfer normalizes line endings before this point. Fix: check for CR presence first with contains before allocating, or fold both replacements into a single-pass scan.
